fastenerSummary: Per ankle: 2 × M2 × 8 TAP from the black PHS_M2X08_TAP_K bag retain the removable orange side. TAP means a self-tapping screw. Reuse the original motor, link, foot and the other listed fasteners.
fitNote: The new sleeve is Ø14.6 outside, Ø10.4 inside and 2.8 mm wide. It can slide on both faces. The modeled clearances can add up to about 0.4 mm of radial movement, so test the small sleeve on the link and in the side before treating the assembled joint as firm. The modeled axial float is about 0.4 mm as well.
statusNote: Digital prototype: printed fit, screw holding and stiffness remain untested. The removable side has only a trial print orientation; its support and surface finish still need slicing review.
checkSummary: The package includes the untouched-source comparison, both candidate assembly paths, joint-range comparison, screw geometry and a print-face review. Those checks concern the model; they do not certify load capacity.
rotationResult: The original solids are clear at the sampled −70° to +70° poses (5° increments), but already overlap by ±75°. The ±90° source setting is not a physically clear range. Printed fit, stiffness and a usable operating range still need measurement.
